name: Brandmark
tagline: Brandmark is an AI logo maker that generates unique logo options from your brand name, industry, and style preferences. It produces vector-format files alongside a full brand kit — colour palette, typography, business card layouts, and social media assets. Startups and freelancers use it to get a professional identity without hiring a designer.
